why: Issue #1015. The resolved load stops checking whether its generation is still current. A close, a surface change, a replace or a teardown during the load then builds the body into a pane that is gone, and a close and reopen builds two bodies side by side -- the generation guard the issue asks for, modelled on the gallery mount in `route-ui.ts`, gone.
